boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented UM-Dearborn rituals and recurring campus gatherings, from pond races to ceremonial processions.

cards.title: Race cardboard boats on Chancellor’s Pond
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn Homecoming
cards.notes: Watch for Homecoming registration, then form a team and build a cardboard boat that can cross Chancellor’s Pond and return afloat.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming race where student organizations and teams test handmade cardboard boats on the pond.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn calls the Cardboard Boat Races an annual campus tradition in which student organizations and athletic teams build cardboard boats and race them across Chancellor’s Pond.
cards.access_notes: Participation details and registration are posted with the annual Homecoming program.

cards.title: Follow the Maize and Blue Bowl
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn Homecoming
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule for the reimagined competition and come ready to support students and alumni competing for the trophy.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Homecoming athletic contest connecting UM-Dearborn students and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn describes the Maize and Blue Bowl as an annual tradition hosted by Student Life, Alumni Engagement and Athletics, with a trophy at stake.
cards.access_notes: The university says the event was being rescheduled and reimagined for Winter 2026; check the Homecoming page for current details.

cards.title: Share the annual Friendsgiving dinner
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Board and Union at Dearborn
cards.notes: Look for the Thursday-before-Thanksgiving gathering and use it as a low-key way to share a meal and meet fellow students.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday dinner that brings together students from varied backgrounds.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn identifies Friendsgiving as an annual holiday tradition organized by the Student Activities Board and the Union at Dearborn.
cards.access_notes: The cited event was held on the Thursday before Thanksgiving; confirm each year’s date and attendance details with Student Life.

cards.title: Make time for Maize Fest
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn Homecoming
cards.notes: Stop by the Homecoming carnival to visit student organizations, join the scheduled activities, and take in the maize-and-blue campus setup.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming gathering with student organizations, games, activities, and food.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn describes Maize Fest as a classic Homecoming activity designed like a carnival, and documents it as a showcase for campus student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by year; consult the current Homecoming schedule for location and activities.

cards.title: Step into Winter Carnival after the address
cards.subtitle: James C. Renick University Center
cards.notes: Pair the State of the University program with the following carnival, then join the listed activities and community gathering in the RUC.
cards.short_summary: A recurring winter campus gathering that follows the State of the University event.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn reported that the campus community went to Winter Carnival after the 2026 State of the University, with firepits, a Bruce the Goose photo booth, live music, and dancing.
cards.source_title: Highlights from the 2026 State of the University
cards.access_notes: Winter Carnival is tied to the State of the University program; watch university event announcements for the next date.

cards.title: Join the annual Hack Dearborn build
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn campus hackathon
cards.notes: Follow the student organizers’ announcements, assemble a project team, and use the event’s mentor and industry connections while you build.
cards.short_summary: An annual UM-Dearborn hackathon that has become a signature student event.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn calls Hack Dearborn the campus’s annual hackathon and reports that it was named Program of the Year at the 2026 Student Leadership Awards.
cards.source_title: Class of Spring 2026: CECS graduate Husniyah Alam
cards.access_notes: The university reports that planning begins in spring for an October event; confirm eligibility and registration with the organizers.

cards.title: Meet people at the International Student Social
cards.subtitle: French Club and Language, Culture, and Arts Department
cards.notes: Watch the French Club and LCA announcements, then bring your curiosity for games, conversation, and an international campus gathering.
cards.short_summary: An annual social hosted by the French Club and UM-Dearborn’s Language, Culture, and Arts Department.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that the International Student Social is hosted annually by the French Club and the Language, Culture, and Arts department.
cards.source_title: A home for everyone: Get to know UM-Dearborn’s campus community
cards.access_notes: Check the French Club or LCA department for the current date, location, and any attendance instructions.

cards.title: Gather at the Homecoming Tailgate
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn Homecoming
cards.notes: Use the Homecoming schedule to find the tailgate, enjoy the listed campus activities, and stay for the corresponding athletic event if offered.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Homecoming gathering before UM-Dearborn athletics, with campus activities and school spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn calls the Homecoming Tailgate a mainstay of its Homecoming week and documents it alongside a Dearborn Wolverines game.
cards.access_notes: Event location, activities, and game pairing vary with the annual Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Start the fall at Wolverine Welcome Day
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn campus
cards.notes: Incoming students should follow orientation instructions for this all-campus welcome day and use it to meet classmates and learn campus routines.
cards.short_summary: The fall orientation finale that introduces new Dearborn Wolverines to campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn describes Wolverine Welcome Day as the final step in the fall orientation process for incoming students and says first-year and transfer participation is required.
cards.access_notes: For fall 2026, the university lists August 25; undergraduate students are automatically registered and graduate students must register.

cards.title: Spot the ceremonial mace at commencement
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn commencement and convocation
cards.notes: At a formal university ceremony, watch for the Faculty Senate chairperson carrying the mace to mark the faculty processional’s arrival.
cards.short_summary: A formal academic procession marked by UM-Dearborn’s walnut-and-copper ceremonial mace.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn says its Faculty Senate chairperson carries the ceremonial mace during commencement, convocation, and other ceremonial events to signify the faculty processional’s arrival.
cards.access_notes: Observe the mace as part of public ceremony programming; attendance requirements and ticketing vary by event.
